landing.hero.headline_1: What do you want to create?
landing.hero.subheadline: Image Agent turns natural language into pixel-perfect edits. Retouch, restyle, generate — one chat, every model.
landing.examples.style.title: Style transfer
landing.examples.style.item_1_prompt: Redraw this photo in Pixar 3D style, keep the pose and outfit unchanged.
landing.examples.style.item_2_prompt: Redraw this person as a Disney animation character: large expressive eyes, smooth 3D shading and warm cinematic lighting.
landing.examples.style.item_3_prompt: Repaint this scene in Studio Ghibli style: hand-painted watercolor backgrounds, lush flowers and warm natural light.
landing.examples.style.item_4_prompt: Turn this person into a 3D cartoon avatar with an oversized head and exaggerated but recognizable features, glossy shading, head-and-shoulders on a solid color background.
landing.examples.makeup.title: Virtual makeup
landing.examples.makeup.item_1_prompt: Virtual try-on: put the T-shirt from the second image on the person in the first image, keeping its print and color, and keeping her pose, face and the background unchanged.
landing.examples.makeup.item_2_prompt: Give her a retro makeup look: matte red lips and winged eyeliner. Keep her features and background unchanged.
landing.examples.makeup.item_3_prompt: Give her a refined smokey eye: smoked brown-grey shadow, defined lashes and a soft nude lip. Keep her features and background unchanged.
landing.examples.makeup.item_4_prompt: Change the hair color to a warm honey-brown with soft highlights, keeping the same hairstyle, features and background.
landing.examples.cover.title: Cover design
landing.examples.cover.item_1_prompt: Design a bold event poster with a large headline and a purple-to-blue gradient.
landing.examples.cover.item_2_prompt: Create a square podcast cover with a minimal illustration and the show title.
landing.examples.cover.item_3_prompt: Make a vertical social post cover with a big headline over a photo backdrop.
landing.examples.cover.item_4_prompt: Design an album cover with a surreal night-sky scene and elegant typography.
landing.examples.logo.title: Logo design
landing.examples.logo.item_1_prompt: Design a logo for an AI image product called "Image Agent": an abstract camera aperture combined with a sparkle, teal gradient, flat vector on white, wordmark underneath.
landing.examples.logo.item_2_prompt: Design a coffee brand logo in minimal single-line-art style: a circular badge, black on off-white, one continuous line forming a coffee bean and steam, "ROAST CO." curved around the circle.
landing.examples.logo.item_3_prompt: Using the attached moodboard for palette and mood, design a logo for an outdoor gear brand called "SUMMIT": a geometric mountain-ridge mark in deep teal and warm amber, flat vector on an off-white background, with the SUMMIT wordmark below.
landing.examples.logo.item_4_prompt: Design a lettermark logo for a tech company: the letter M built from clean geometric cuts, blue to violet gradient, flat vector centered on white, with the wordmark "MOMENTUM" in a modern sans below.

landing.pricing.title: Pricing
landing.faq.title: Everything you need to know about Image Agent
landing.faq.q_1: What is Image Agent and how does it work?
landing.faq.a_1: Image Agent works from plain language: describe what you want, and it edits, restyles, or generates the image using the best model for the job. No layers, no menus — just the conversation.
landing.faq.q_2: Is Image Agent really free to use?
landing.faq.a_2: Yes. The Free plan gives you 80 credits per month with full access to every supported model. Upgrade only when you need more.
landing.faq.q_3: What makes Image Agent different from other AI image editors?
landing.faq.a_3: Most editors lock you into one model and one workflow. Image Agent gives you 9 models, a node-based infinite canvas, and full version history — all from a single chat.
landing.faq.q_4: What types of images can I create with Image Agent?
landing.faq.a_4: Photo retouching, ID photos, product shots, character art, style transfers, restorations, removals — anything you can describe, Image Agent can attempt.
landing.faq.q_5: How does Image Agent protect my privacy?
landing.faq.a_5: Your images are encrypted in transit and at rest. We never train on your uploads. You can permanently delete any project or asset at any time.
landing.faq.q_6: Can I use the generated images commercially?
landing.faq.a_6: Yes. All paid plans include a full commercial license. The Free plan also permits commercial use with attribution.
landing.faq.q_7: Are there any limitations to using Image Agent?
landing.faq.a_7: Each plan has a monthly credit limit and a max upload file size. Heavy bursts are smoothed via a fair-use queue.
landing.faq.q_8: Do I need to create an account to use Image Agent?
landing.faq.a_8: Yes — an account lets us save your edits, version history, and credit balance. Sign-up takes 10 seconds via email or Google/GitHub.
landing.faq.q_9: Is Image Agent available on mobile devices?
landing.faq.a_9: Image Agent is a fully responsive web app. A dedicated iOS and Android app is on the roadmap.
landing.faq.q_10: How can I provide feedback or report issues?
landing.faq.a_10: Hit the feedback button in the dashboard, or email us — we read every message and ship fixes weekly.

admin.settings.tips.default_llm_provider: Auto uses OpenAI when its API key is set, otherwise Anthropic. Credentials come from the provider cards below.
admin.settings.tips.agent_model: Model id as the chosen provider names it. Required for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, which all name models differently.
admin.settings.tips.openai_base_url: Include the version segment — the client appends /chat/completions.
admin.settings.tips.anthropic_base_url: Host only — the client appends /v1/messages. Gateways expose this protocol on their own path (gRouter: /api/anthropic).
admin.settings.tips.adsense_code: Your AdSense publisher ID — also used to generate /ads.txt
admin.settings.tips.creem_product_ids_ma: Map the product_id in pricing catalog to the product ID created in Creem. Must be a valid JSON object.
admin.settings.tips.default_image_provid: Auto prefers gRouter when it is configured, then Replicate, then Fal. Applies to both text-to-image and image editing.
admin.settings.tips.google_one_tap_enabl: Show the Google One Tap prompt to signed-out visitors. Requires Client ID.
admin.settings.tips.grouter_model_map: Optional JSON mapping the picker model key to the route name configured in your gateway. Defaults to the key itself (e.g. gpt-image-2).
admin.settings.tips.plausible_domain: Optional for the new site-specific script; required by legacy scripts
admin.settings.tips.plausible_src: Paste the complete site-specific script URL from Plausible, or leave blank to use the legacy cloud script
admin.settings.tips.r2_endpoint: Leave empty to use the default R2 endpoint
admin.settings.tips.r2_upload_path: Path to upload files to; leave empty to use the default. Example: uploads/foo/bar
admin.settings.tips.signup_ip_daily_limi: Caps how many accounts one address may open in 24 hours, so the signup credit grant cannot be farmed. 0 disables the cap; blank uses the default of 5.
admin.settings.tips.grouter_base_url: A self-hosted OpenAI-compatible image gateway. Leave the whole group blank unless you run one.
